verdict.rationale: Headless or CI operation is a fair question for an authenticator or password manager, since products of this kind can ship CLIs or callable endpoints. The evidence shows none for 2FAS: its own llms.txt declares 'Public API: None', with no agent-callable endpoint for token generation. Browser-extension access must also be confirmed on the mobile app, which rules out unattended runs, and the agent-friendly docs plumbing (llms.txt, .md mirrors) is documentation, not a way to run the product headlessly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
